ggml-cpu : size set_rows conversion buffer for all threads ( #30454 )

- ggml-cpu : size set_rows conversion buffer for all threads

SET_ROWS is planned with n_tasks = 1, but every thread runs it and uses its own row of the F16 -> F32 conversion buffer, so threads > 0 wrote past the work buffer when the graph had another multi-threaded op.

- move set_rows to n_task = n_threads group
